# Framework API (v1)

`import { Game } from './core.mjs'; import { CHARACTERS, ATTRIBUTES, ITEMS, RECIPES, RULES } from './data.mjs';`

- All catalogs are arrays. Characters `{id,name,role,description,skillId,skillName,initialLevels,model,attributeCap,skillCap}`. Attributes `{id,name,expThresholds,description}`. Items `{id,name,type,level,cost,duration,stack,...explicit properties,model:null}`. Recipes are craftable items (ammo parent ITM_005 excluded; A–E present).
- `new Game({random:Math.random}={})` starts CHR_003 with three independent records. `game.state`: `{version:1,activeId,characters,story,realTime,worldTime,attacks:[],counterOpportunity:null,target:{id,type,hp,maxHp,stun,armor},vehicle:{id,hp,maxHp,moving,distance},log:[]}`. log entries `{time,text}`.
- `game.character`: active character state `{id,levels:{health,stamina,shooting,driving,strength,charm,intelligence,luck},exp:{...same},distance:{run,swim,jump,climb,drive},hp,stamina,skillLevel,skill:{active,energy,cooldown,remaining,thinking},inventory:[],armor:null,craft:null,use:null,bandageCooldown,bleeding:false,ammo:30,ammoPools:{rifle,pistol,smg,sniper,shotgun}}`. Initial skill levels 0. Luo energy 100, Xu 0, Xia 0 thought points.
- `game.definition`: active catalog character.
- `game.stats()` returns `{maxHp,maxStamina,moveMultiplier,stabilityMultiplier,reloadMultiplier,handlingMultiplier,vehicleSpeedMultiplier,meleeDamageMultiplier,meleeSpeedMultiplier,socialMultiplier,craftSpeedMultiplier,craftWasteMultiplier,positiveChanceMultiplier,negativeChanceMultiplier,attributeCap,skillCap,skillDuration,skillMaxEnergy,skillRechargePerSecond,dodgeChance,dodgeWindow,counterWindow,damageReduction,shootingDamageMultiplier,skillMeleeMultiplier,timeScale}`. Rates are multipliers on level-0 base. `game.timeScale` gives current global scale.
- `game.nextExp(attribute)` returns numeric threshold or null at cap / unconfigured Luo 5→6.
- All commands return `{ok:boolean,message:string,...}`; invalid commands do not throw. UI may show returned message. `game.tick(realDt)` advances timers (real seconds for charging/cooldown, world seconds for attacks/crafting/effects), resolves incoming attacks and craft/use completion.
- `game.setCharacter(id)`, `game.activateSkill()` (Luo toggle, Xu activate, Xia returns `openBook:true`), `game.toggleThinking()`, `game.enterStory(bool=true)`, `game.setSkillLevel(integer)` (configuration preview only, no invented skill XP).
- `game.perform(action,payload={})`: `run/swim/jump/climb/drive` with `{distance:number,moving:true}` (drive requires moving true); `walk` with `{distance}`; `shoot` with `{hit:true,damage:20,ammoType:null}`; `melee` with `{hit:true,damage:10}`; `social/craft` with `{success:true}`; `heal` with `{amount:30}`; `rest` restores stamina (demo); `damage` with `{damage:20,type:'bullet'}` convenience. Defaults only for sandbox interactions; callers choose distance/outcomes. Run/swim XP per full 10m; jump/climb per full 1m; drive per full 100m, fractions retained.
- `game.queueAttack({damage:20,type:'bullet'|'explosion'|'melee',delay:2,unitClass:'light'|'medium'|'heavy'})` schedules world seconds. `game.receiveAttack({damage,type,armorPiercing:false})` immediate damage. `game.dodge()` attempts earliest incoming eligible attack; `game.counter()` uses successful perfect-dodge opportunity. `game.dodgeAvailable()` returns attack or null. `game.counterAvailable` getter boolean.
- `game.startCraft(itemId)` for Xia, requires unlocked level and thought points, deducts points now; `character.craft={itemId,remaining,duration}` completes to inventory and grants 50 intelligence EXP; cost and duration ignore intelligence bonuses. `game.cancelCraft()` cancels and refunds points.
- Inventory stack `{uid,itemId,quantity,charges?,durability?}`; tasers and armor have separate instance stacks. `game.giveItem(itemId,quantity=1)` is explicit sandbox/developer provisioning. `game.useItem(itemId,{uid?,distance?,directHit?,unitClass?,ammoType?})` auto chooses first matching stack unless uid supplied. Bomb queued detonation; bandage timed 3s; taser consumes20 energy and removes at zero; repair requires `state.vehicle.moving=false`, distance<=2, completes in8s then consumes; ammo transfers stack quantity into ammo pool; armor equips and preserves previous armor durability on unequip. `game.interruptUse()` cancels bandage/repair. `game.repairArmor(amount)` backend hook preserves max100, no invented repair recipe/cost.
- `game.snapshot()` JSON-safe complete state; `game.restore(data)` validates version/data and restores while clamping values. Restore pauses active combat, thinking and item use; paid crafting and resource/cooldown values persist, with no offline rewards. Use browser localStorage outside engine. `game.reset()` starts fresh state.
- `game.randomChance(base,'positive'|'negative')` returns bounded chance (0–1). Luck not upgradeable.

Pending design: Luo attribute 5→6 EXP and fastest-growth numerical multiplier; exact skill level-up acquisition; total skill range provisionally 0–5 and Luo0–6. No automatic invented progression. Current attribute caps five/six. Skill preview selector changes values explicitly for testing. Timers, damage amounts, item catalog, initial levels, base thresholds otherwise follow supplied specification.
